messages:
marta: FYI were co-hosting a partner webinar with SkylineMarket + ForgeSystems on Tues 11am PT. Need: final speaker list, 1-page demo runbook, slide deck, demo kit manifest, and swag approvals by Fri EOD. Drive: https://drive.example.com/skyline-forge -> assign owners pls.
jules: Added to calendar. Whos owning shipping for demo kits?
harry: I can own shipping. How many stations?
marta: Venue map has 3 stations + 1 backup. Ship 5 kits (3 active, 1 backup, 1 spare). Weight ~9kg/kit. For EU customs use HS 8471 + commercial invoice.
meena: I'll run the live demo. Quick: do we want q4-quant (low latency) or v2-high (better quality) for the live model?
harry: Suggest q4-quant primary, v2-high as fallback. If hardware flakes, switch routing to hosted-phase.
jules: I'll do slides + partner co-branding. Need SVG logos and co-branding guidelines. @marta can you confirm assets uploaded?
marta: Logos and one co-brand template uploaded to Drive. Also partners requested a 2-slide partner intro.
ops-bot: Reminder: Rehearsal scheduled Mon 10:00am PT in Zoom "Partner-Rehearse"  invites sent.
harry: AV checklist for booth: Edge unit, HDMI->DP adapter, ethernet, power strip, USB-C power, monitor. Who can own booth handoff at 10:20am?
jules: I can handle booth handoff and slide upload. Please put final deck in Drive by Mon EOD.
meena: I'll run a morning test on Mon to repro an intermittent kernel mismatch I saw last week. Posting results after tests.
marta: Run order proposal:
```
1) 11:00 Welcome (marta)
2) 11:03 SkylineMarket keynote (partner)
3) 11:12 Live demo (meena)
4) 11:28 Panel + Q&A (jules + partners)
```
harry: Swag: partners prefer low-touch merch in EU. Plan: stickers + postcard EU, sticker pack + enamel pin US. Need customs clearance for pins (may be flagged).
jules: Marketing wants two co-branded headshots for the speaker panel. Partners to provide by Thu.
meena: I'll prepare a 90s canned demo clip as fallback and upload to the folder.
harry: Shipping note: courier needs pro forma and HS code on manifest. I'll add templates to the shipping folder.
marta: Whos moderating Q&A? single person to field chat and hand off to partners.
jules: I can moderate. Can partner reps join the 10:00 rehearsal?
meena: Yes, ForgeSystems will join rehearsal and test screen share. Skyline asked for latency numbers to decide model variant. I'll post latency + cold-start numbers after Monday tests.
ops-bot: Venue note: No powered lithium batteries allowed. Confirm all kits shipped without batteries.
harry: Confirmed, kits will be DC-powered only. Ill image all kits with firmware 4.1.2 (fixes model load bug).
marta: Security: dont put routing tokens in slides. Use short-lived guest token stored in keyring.
jules: Also request that analytics track QR click-throughs. Can someone create a shortlink with UTM?
harry: I'll create rwd.link/skyforge for tracking and put in the postcard QR.
marta: Great. Final checklist: slides + bios by Mon EOD, shipping manifest Wed AM, rehearsal Mon 10:00am. Call out blockers here. :rocket:
